reading.body:
This Meta facility in Eagle Mountain, Utah County, has no published power capacity. The operator's spec page does not disclose megawatts, so its size relative to the 52.18 MW of published AI data center capacity in Utah cannot be determined from available facts. Utah has 21 mapped facilities, of which 9 publish power figures, placing this campus tenth by disclosed capacity among a state where most facilities remain unquantified.

Meta operates this site as a company-owned and operated asset within its broader data center expansion program, though the specific opening date, investment figure, and building count are not confirmed in available sources. The research status is exhausted, meaning no additional operational details were located despite systematic searching. This facility exists as a confirmed location but remains opaque in its specifications.

For a reader assessing whether this campus matters to AI scaling, the lack of published capacity makes assessment impossible from this data. The campus may hold significant power and compute, or it may be minor infrastructure. The only certainty is that Meta has claimed the site and continues to expand data center footprint, but whether this particular location is material to national AI compute capacity cannot be read from facts provided.
